issues.TERM_CATEGORY_WEIGHT_TOTAL: Term category weights total {{total}}%; they must total 100%.
issues.ANNUAL_WEIGHT_TOTAL: Term weights plus whole-year category weights total {{total}}%; they must total 100%.
issues.MAX_MARKS_INVALID: Maximum marks must be greater than 0.
issues.PASS_PERCENTAGE_INVALID: The passing percentage must be between 0 and 100.
issues.FINAL_EXAM_PASS_PERCENTAGE_INVALID: The final exam passing percentage must be between 0 and 100.
issues.ROUNDING_DECIMALS_INVALID: Rounding must keep between 0 and 4 decimal places.
issues.RETAKE_CAP_REQUIRED: A capped retake policy needs a cap between 0 and 100%.
issues.NO_CATEGORIES: Add at least one assessment category.
issues.TERM_WEIGHT_MISSING: There are term categories, but no term carries any weight in the year's grade.
issues.TERM_WEIGHT_WITHOUT_TERM_CATEGORIES: Terms carry weight, but there are no term categories to build a term grade from.
issues.WEIGHT_IGNORED_FOR_TOTAL_POINTS: Category weights are ignored when the subject is graded by total points.
issues.FINAL_EXAM_RULE_WITHOUT_FINAL: The final exam must be passed on its own, but no category is a final exam.
issues.DESCRIPTORS_REQUIRED: Set up this grade's descriptor scale: at least two descriptors, such as Excellent and Needs improvement.
issues.DESCRIPTOR_POINTS_PARTIAL: Give every descriptor points, or none. A subject descriptor is only worked out when all have points.
issues.DESCRIPTOR_NOT_ACHIEVED_UNUSED: A descriptor is marked "not achieved", but without points no subject descriptor is worked out, so no pupil fails this subject.
issues.NO_SKILLS: Add at least one skill to assess.
issues.CREDITS_DIFFER_FROM_COEFFICIENT: This subject's credits differ from its weight in the overall average. The weight is what counts in the average and GPA; schools that weight by credit hours set both to the same number.

statusHelp.draft: Draft: rules can be changed freely and teachers can't enter marks yet. Publish when the checklist is done.
statusHelp.active: Published: teachers enter marks. Rule changes that affect recorded marks need confirmation.
statusHelp.finalized: Finalized: the rules are locked. Results can still be corrected and certificates issued.

overview.publishDescription: Teachers can start entering marks once the year is published.
overview.publishBlocked: Fix the problems below before publishing.

draft.title: Move back to draft?
draft.description: Only possible while no marks have been recorded. Teachers lose access to mark entry until you publish again.

finalized.title: Finalize the year's grading?
finalized.description: Rules are locked for good. Make sure every section's results are finalized first.

archived.title: Archive this year?
archived.description: The year becomes read-only. Certificates stay available.

start.title: Start the year's configuration

subjects.title: Add subjects and grading rules
subjects.help: Each grade's subjects, categories, weights and assessments. Every section inherits them.

sections.title: Review sections
sections.help: Customize or exclude subjects for individual sections, and resolve outdated overrides.

teachers.title: Assign teachers
teachers.help: Every subject in every section needs a teacher to enter marks.

publish.title: Publish
publish.help: Publishing checks everything above and opens mark entry to teachers.

overview.noGrades: No grades are set up for this year yet.

copy.neverCopied: Marks, results and certificates are never copied.
copy.done: The configuration was copied. Review it before publishing.

subjects.noGrades: Add grades on the Grades & sections page first.
subjects.heading: {{grade}} subjects
subjects.caption: Subjects of {{grade}}
subjects.inheritHelp: These are the grade's defaults. Every section of the grade inherits them unless it has its own override.
subjects.removeDescription: The subject is removed from the grade and from every section that inherits it. Subjects with marks can't be removed.

program.heading: {{grade}} policies
program.notSetUp: This grade isn't set up for this year yet. Save its policies to start adding subjects.
program.maxFailed: Most failed subjects for supplementary exams
program.maxFailedHelp: Failing more subjects than this means the student is retained.
program.approval: Marks need approval before results are finalized
program.resultFormatHelp: How the year's final result appears on results and certificates. The percentage is always shown alongside.
program.outOfMaxHelp: For example 20: an average of 82.5% shows as 16.5 / 20.
program.gpaMaxHelp: Usually 4 or 5. Each subject's GPA points come from its grading scale and are weighted like the average.
program.predictedVisibilityHelp: Teachers' notes on a predicted grade are always for staff only.

rank.heading: Class rank
rank.enabledHelp: Gives each student a rank and percentile on their finalized results, and lists the grade's top students. Only complete results are ranked; tied students share a place.
rank.basisHelp: Ranking by GPA needs the final result shown as a GPA.
rank.scopeHelp: A grade-wide rank appears once every section of the grade is finalized for the period.
rank.visibilityHelp: When students and parents see it, it also appears in their app and on the report cards, certificates and transcripts issued to them.

program.pointsMaxHelp: 45 for the IB Diploma: six subjects at 7 plus up to 3 core points.

editor.gradeDefaultHelp: Every section of the grade inherits these rules unless it overrides them.
editor.sectionHelp: These rules apply to this section only.
editor.hasMarks_one: {{count}} mark is already recorded under these rules.
editor.hasMarks_other: {{count}} marks are already recorded under these rules.
editor.locked: This year's grading is finalized or archived, so these rules are read-only.
editor.readOnly: You can view these rules but not change them.
editor.finalExamPassHelp: Leave empty if the final exam doesn't have to be passed on its own.
editor.averageWeightHelp: 1 counts like any other subject; 2 counts double.

editor.courseLevelHelp: Shown next to the subject, e.g. Honors, AP, HL or SL. Optional.
editor.gpaBoostHelp: Added to the subject's GPA points for the weighted GPA when it is passed: usually 0.5 for Honors and 1 for AP. The regular GPA doesn't change. 0 for none.
editor.teachersCanAdd: Teachers can add their own assessments
editor.termWeightsHelp: How much each term counts toward the year's grade.
editor.noTerms: This academic year has no terms yet.
editor.categoriesHelpWeighted: Each term's grade is built from its term categories by weight. Whole-year categories count directly in the year's grade.
editor.categoriesHelpTotal: All marks are added up and divided by the total of their maximums; weights are not used.
editor.noAssessments: No assessments in this category yet.
editor.annualTotal: Term weights plus whole-year categories total {{total}}% of 100%
editor.totalPointsNoWeights: Graded by total points, so there are no weights to check.

descriptive.zeroIsLowest: For descriptive subjects, "counts as zero" means the lowest descriptor.
descriptive.notInAverage: Descriptive subjects never count in the average. They still appear on report cards and certificates.

descriptive.noWeights: Descriptive subjects have no weights or marks to total.

descriptive.scaleInvalid: A scale needs at least two descriptors, each with a name.
descriptive.pointsHelp: Used to work out a subject's overall descriptor.
descriptive.label: Descriptor

externalExams.heading: External exams
externalExams.help: The external exams your students sit — SAT, IELTS, IGCSE finals, national exams and others. Add a built-in exam and adjust it, or define your own. Exams belong to the school, not to one academic year.
externalExams.caption: The school's external exams
externalExams.empty: No external exams yet. Add a built-in exam to start.
externalExams.archiveDescription: No new results can be recorded for an archived exam. Results already recorded stay, and you can restore it later.
externalExams.lockedNote: Results are recorded for this exam, so its total, the per-subject setting and how each scored part is scored can no longer change. Names, the total's range and transcript visibility still can.
externalExams.name: Name
externalExams.roundingStepHelp: For example 0.5 for an IELTS overall band. Leave empty for two decimals.
externalExams.perSubjectLabel: One result per subject (for example IGCSE or AP)
externalExams.componentsHelp: Each part is scored as a number in a range, or as one grade from a list. A sum or an average needs every part scored as a number.
externalExams.labelsHelp: Separated by commas, in the order to list them (for example A*, A, B, C).
externalExams.valid: This exam is ready to save.

toefl_ibt.name: TOEFL iBT
toefl_ibt.note: TOEFL iBT is moving to a 1-6 band scale; edit the sections' ranges for new score reports.

tawjihi.name: Tawjihi (General Secondary Education Certificate)
tawjihi.note: Default subjects, each marked 0-100, averaged into a percentage. Edit the subjects and their maximums to match the student's stream and the ministry's current rules; the ministry's weighting of subjects is not applied.

thanaweya_amma.name: Thanaweya Amma (General Secondary Certificate)
thanaweya_amma.note: Default subjects, each marked out of 100, totalled. The ministry changes subjects and maximums: edit them, and the total's maximum, to match the student's track and year.

state_assessment.name: State assessment
state_assessment.note: Rename it after your state's test. The levels and the scale score's range differ by state and subject: edit them. The scale score is optional when recording a result.

graduation.heading: Graduation requirements
graduation.help: What a student needs to graduate: credits, credits in a group of subjects, subjects passed, a cumulative GPA or average, or an external exam. Students are checked against their finalized annual results of every year and their recorded test scores. A set applies to the grade levels you choose, from an academic year on if you set one.
